his_statement: bonne réduction virtuelle d’échelon n (parent question; the restricted theorem below is not attributed to the manuscript)
statement: Let K be a finite extension of Q_p with p>2 and X a p-divisible group over K. Suppose X has a finite filtration by strict p-divisible subgroups whose graded groups extend over O_K. If, after a finite extension L/K, X_L admits such a filtration with at most n nonzero graded groups, then X already admits such a filtration with at most n over K.
